name: Gotsumon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Hudie] trait and 1 Tamer card or Option card with the [CS] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower Digimon card with the [Hudie] trait from your hand without paying the cost. The Digimon this effect played can't digivolve and is deleted at the end of your opponent's turn.
